body:
New /admin/gfd-items page + CRUD API (GfdItemsHandler/GfdItemsPageHandler), same direct-file-access precedent KanbanHandler's own BacklogPath already established -- reads/writes GoblinFoxDragon/data/items.json directly via GFD_ITEMS_JSON_PATH, gated behind iduna.admin permission. Honest limitation named on the page: apps2/mud only loads items.json at startup, not live-reloaded. 10 new tests (CRUD + rejection cases + a real field-name round-trip check), go build/vet/test ./... clean. Redeployed the live IDUNA instance (real DB backup taken first), live-verified: /admin/gfd-items returns a real 401 (route registered, correctly auth-gated). Commit 34dec77.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD Item Builder Phase 2a: real admin GUI shipped and deployed
